> > > Fact From Story: Retailers are really pushing out discounts to get people more willing to spend money this year.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Retailers want people to spend money at their stores.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Reducing the price of an item makes people more willing to buy it.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Discounts encourage people to spend more money.
